overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the May 5 site visit had no quorum present, so it was not a meeting and no notice was required.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board held a meeting, a May 5 site visit to the power station property, without posting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because no quorum was present during the May 5 site visit, no meeting took place.
